**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 24 sits at (not merely near) our preferred position on every material term:

- **24.1** — Customer may assign without Vendor consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets; only prompt notice and assignee assumption are required.
- **24.2** — Vendor may not assign, delegate material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent (not unreasonably withheld for a capable, financially sound assignee), and never to a direct Customer competitor.
- **24.3** — Residual assignments are subject to a mutual "not unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed" standard.
- **24.4** — Our change of control gives Vendor no right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service, and Vendor must cooperate with successor administrative changes.

Cross-checks: Section 13.3 keys licence transfer to permitted Section 24 assignments (consistent, no gap). Section 9.2 is a conventional mutual insolvency termination right and expressly carves out lawful reorganizations that do not impair performance, so it is not a back-door change-of-control exit. No walk-away features are present.
